# monogenesis

> Track and improve your vocabulary in multiple languages with customizable decks and interactive 3D flash cards.
> Website: https://monogenesis.org/
> Manifest: https://monogenesis.org/llms.txt
> Full AI Documentation: https://monogenesis.org/llms-full.txt

## Overview
monogenesis is a minimalist, zen-inspired vocabulary acquisition and flash card platform supporting 100+ world languages. Learners organize words into customizable decks (e.g. Nouns (practice), Nouns (mastered), Colours, Numbers, Verbs, or custom topics), record pronunciation notes, and study with interactive 3D flippable flash cards translated dynamically into their fluent base language.

## Core Capabilities
- **100+ Supported Languages**: Study Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Russian, Georgian, Korean, Arabic, Indonesian, Portuguese, Italian, and 90+ other global languages simultaneously.
- **Dynamic Base-Language Translation**: Automatically translates vocabulary definitions and UI strings into any native or preferred base language on the fly.
- **CEFR-Aligned Milestone Tracking**: Framework designed around the non-linear, exponential jumps of vocabulary acquisition from A1 (500 words) to C2 (16,000+ words).
- **Customizable & Auto Decks**: Drag-and-drop custom ordering, instant search across all card fields, move words between decks, and track mastery.
- **Offline-First Cloud Sync**: Instant optimistic UI with AWS Lambda and DynamoDB cloud synchronization via Google OAuth.
- **Minimalist Zen Interface**: Pure, distraction-free environment for polyglots, students, and language enthusiasts.

## CEFR Vocabulary Framework
Language acquisition is non-linear. Each milestone unlocks expanding communicative capabilities:

| CEFR Level | Tier | Total Word Families | Words to Next Tier | What You Can Express |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **A1** | A1 | 500 | +250 | Basic greetings, simple requests, and core everyday words to get started. |
| **A1** | A1+ | 750 | +250 | Simple descriptions, asking common questions, and connecting basic ideas. |
| **A2** | A2 | 1,000 | +500 | Everyday conversations about family, shopping, dining out, and work. |
| **A2** | A2+ | 1,500 | +500 | Talking about past trips, personal plans, and daily experiences. |
| **B1** | B1 | 2,000 | +1,000 | Sharing personal opinions, discussing goals, and handling everyday travel on your own. |
| **B1** | B1+ | 3,000 | +1,000 | Explaining complex points, following podcasts or videos, and chatting more naturally. |
| **B2** | B2 | 4,000 | +2,000 | Fluent workplace conversations, spontaneous banter, and common idioms. |
| **B2** | B2+ | 6,000 | +2,000 | Handling technical discussions, cultural humor, and active debates comfortably. |
| **C1** | C1 | 8,000 | +8,000 | Academic reading, nuanced writing, jokes, and expressing subtle shades of meaning. |
| **C2** | C2 | 16,000+ | — | Complete near-native fluency across virtually any topic or context. |

## Supported Languages (ISO 639-1)
- **English** (`en`), **Spanish** (`es`), **French** (`fr`), **German** (`de`), **Italian** (`it`), **Portuguese** (`pt`), **Russian** (`ru`), **Georgian** (`ka`), **Japanese** (`ja`), **Chinese (Simplified)** (`zh`), **Chinese (Traditional)** (`zh-TW`), **Korean** (`ko`), **Arabic** (`ar`), **Hindi** (`hi`), **Indonesian** (`id`), **Vietnamese** (`vi`), **Thai** (`th`), **Turkish** (`tr`), **Polish** (`pl`), **Ukrainian** (`uk`), **Dutch** (`nl`), **Greek** (`el`), **Czech** (`cs`), **Swedish** (`sv`), **Hungarian** (`hu`), **Romanian** (`ro`), **Danish** (`da`), **Finnish** (`fi`), **Norwegian** (`no`), **Hebrew** (`he`), **Slovak** (`sk`), **Bulgarian** (`bg`), **Croatian** (`hr`), **Serbian** (`sr`), **Lithuanian** (`lt`), **Latvian** (`lv`), **Estonian** (`et`), **Slovenian** (`sl`), **Irish** (`ga`), **Welsh** (`cy`), **Tagalog** (`tl`), **Swahili** (`sw`), and 60+ more.

## Key URLs & Application Routes
- **Home**: `https://monogenesis.org/#/`
- **About & CEFR Framework**: `https://monogenesis.org/#/about`
- **Study Languages**: `https://monogenesis.org/#/languages`
- **Decks Overview**: `https://monogenesis.org/#/languages/{langCode}/decks`
- **Word Manager & Search**: `https://monogenesis.org/#/languages/{langCode}/decks/{deckId}`
- **Flashcard Study Mode**: `https://monogenesis.org/#/languages/{langCode}/decks/{deckId}/study`
- **Sign In / Account Sync**: `https://monogenesis.org/#/signin`
